column1: # Large-group premium rates in DMHC-regulated plans rose 10.7% in 2024, the most in the decade shown, and 6.5% in 2025.

# Source: California Department of Managed Health Care, Health Plan Aggregate Premium Rate Report, Measurement Year 2025. Weighted average rate change for large-group plans (employers with more than 100 workers) regulated by DMHC; about 7.5 million members in 2025. Plans expected 8.5% for 2026. Values in percent.
